start.title: A Question Burns
start.text:
You see Jesus on the road.
A question burns inside you.

choices.text: Run past, too proud to ask

choices.feedback: Mark 10:17 — The man ran up to Jesus and knelt before him.

pride_consequence.title: Do Not Walk On
pride_consequence.text:
The question will not leave you.
Go and ask him.

eternal_life.title: Good Teacher
eternal_life.text:
You kneel. "What must I do
to inherit eternal life?"

choices.feedback: Truth is not bought with haste.
Mark 10:18 — Jesus responded to the man's question about eternal life.

choices.text: Boast of your good deeds first

demand_consequence.title: Be Still
demand_consequence.text:
Eternal things ask quiet hearts.
Wait and listen.

boast_consequence.title: Listen First
boast_consequence.text:
Boasting closes the ear.
Let him speak.

commandments.title: You Know Them
commandments.text:
"Do not kill, steal, or lie.
Honor your father and mother."

choices.feedback: Mark 10:19 — Jesus listed several commandments for the man.

choices.text: Brush them off as too easy

easy_consequence.title: Weigh Them
easy_consequence.text:
The commandments are not small.
Receive them again.

claim.title: All My Life
claim.text:
"All these I have kept
since I was a boy."

choices.feedback: Mark 10:20 — The man told Jesus that he had kept all these commandments since his youth.

lie_consequence.title: Be Honest
lie_consequence.text:
He sees the corners of your soul.
Speak the truth.

challenge.title: One Thing You Lack
challenge.text:
"Sell what you own, give to
the poor, and follow me."

choices.text: Argue that wealth is a gift
choices.feedback: Gifts are meant to be shared.
He asked for all of you.

choices.text: Sit with the weight of his words
choices.feedback: Mark 10:21 — Jesus told the man he lacked one thing: to sell his possessions, give to the poor, and follow Him.

argue_consequence.title: Do Not Argue
argue_consequence.text:
He is not asking to take.
He is offering freedom.

choices.text: Sit with the weight of his words

bargain_consequence.title: All, Not Some
bargain_consequence.text:
Half a heart cannot follow him.
He asks for all.

choices.text: Sit with the weight of his words

conflict.title: The Heart Weighs
conflict.text:
Your gold feels heavy in your hand.
Your soul feels heavier.

choices.text: Open your hands to let go
choices.feedback: Mark 10:22 — The man's face fell because he had great wealth.

surrender_path.title: Almost
surrender_path.text:
You almost let go.
But the weight is too great.

walk_away.title: Sorrowful
walk_away.text:
You turn away, deeply sad.
Your wealth holds you back.

choices.feedback: Mark 10:22 — The man went away sorrowful because he had many possessions.

forget_consequence.title: Do Not Forget
forget_consequence.text:
His eyes still find you.
Remember what you felt.

choices.text: Carry his words in your heart

teaching.title: Hard for the Rich
teaching.text:
"How hard for the rich
to enter the kingdom of God."

choices.text: Despair, for who can be saved?
Trust that all is possible with God
choices.feedback: Mark 10:23 — Jesus taught his disciples how difficult it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God.

despair_consequence.title: With God
despair_consequence.text:
What is impossible for us
is possible with God.

choices.text: Trust that all is possible with God

ending.title: With God, All Things
ending.text:
What riches could not buy,
grace freely gives.
